integrity: The lower bound uses only Krawczyk’s explicit bijection-indexed construction and pairwise-distinctness theorem plus an elementary exact count of the index set. The upper bound is Fritz’s exact cardinality theorem as reproduced in Krawczyk’s article. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes the cardinality of the neighborhood-unsound C-Post complete subclass in the standard countable one-operator language; it does not determine the exact size of the neighborhood-complete subclass or finer invariants of the examples.
title: Exactly continuum many Post-complete congruential modal logics are neighborhood-unsound
